# 🐟 Species and countries

These functions take the fishing area data of
[`fishing_area_data()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fishing_area_data.md)
(here area 34) and look at one species or one country.
[`country_analysis()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_analysis.md)
looks at a country in all FAO areas.

``` r

FAO34 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central")
```

## 1️⃣ `species_country()`: who catches a species

Names must match the FAO species names exactly; the main species of an
area are a good start:

``` r

top <- aggregate(Production ~ ASFIS.species..Name., data = FAO34$area_data, FUN = sum)
head(top[order(-top$Production), "ASFIS.species..Name."], 10)
#>  [1] "European pilchard(=Sardine)"  "Marine fishes nei"           
#>  [3] "Jack and horse mackerels nei" "Sardinellas nei"             
#>  [5] "Round sardinella"             "Atlantic chub mackerel"      
#>  [7] "Bonga shad"                   "Skipjack tuna"               
#>  [9] "European anchovy"             "Yellowfin tuna"
```

``` r

sardine <- species_country(FAO34$area_data, species_name = "European pilchard(=Sardine)")
```

| File | Chart |
|----|----|
| `<species>_country_map.png` | Catch of the species by country over all years, on a world map |
| `species/<species>_country_ranked_total.png` | Total catch and share of the ten main countries |
| `species/<species>_country_ranked.png` | Their catch over time |
| `species/<species>_country_ranked_wrap.png` | One panel per country, with share, linear trend and breakpoints |
| `species/<species>_country_pie_selected.png` | Shares of the main countries per decade and in each recent year |

The table `tables/<species>_country_ranked_table.csv` has the average
catch per decade, the catch in the last five years and the share of each
country in the last year:

``` r

table <- read.csv("tables/European_pilchard__Sardine__country_ranked_table.csv",
                  fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM", check.names = FALSE)
show_table(table, n = 10, digits = 0)
```

### Options

| Argument | Meaning | Default |
|----|----|----|
| `species_name` | FAO species name |  |
| `rank_range` | Ranks of the countries shown | `c(1, 10)` |
| `timeseries_analysis` | Breakpoints in the panel chart (else a smooth curve) | `TRUE` |
| `h_value` | Minimum period length for breakpoints (fraction or years) | `0.15` |
| `polygon_color`, `fill_scale` | Map borders and palette | `"grey90"`, map palette of [`fao_settings()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_settings.md) |
| `axis_*`, `strip_*`, `legend_text_size_map` | Text sizes and faces |  |
| `table`, `plot`, `lang`, `pptx` | Outputs and language |  |

Tuna series are short in some countries; a larger `h_value` gives
clearer breakpoints:

``` r

species_country(FAO34$area_data, species_name = "Skipjack tuna", h_value = 5, lang = "zh")
```

## 2️⃣ `country_species()`: what a country catches in the area

``` r

morocco <- country_species(FAO34$area_data, country_name = "Morocco")
```

![Morocco_species_ranked_total.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/country/Morocco_species_ranked_total.png`

![Morocco_species_ranked.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/country/Morocco_species_ranked.png`

![Morocco_species_ranked_wrap.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/country/Morocco_species_ranked_wrap.png`

![Morocco_species_pie_selected.png](data:image/png;base64,)

`figures/png/country/Morocco_species_pie_selected.png`

| File | Chart |
|----|----|
| `country/<country>_species_ranked_total.png` | Total catch and share of the country’s ten main species |
| `country/<country>_species_ranked.png` | Their catch over time |
| `country/<country>_species_ranked_wrap.png` | One panel per species, with share, trend and breakpoints |
| `country/<country>_species_pie_selected.png` | Species shares per decade and in each recent year |

`time_analysis_text_displacement` moves the share labels in the panel
chart (years after the first catch), useful when they overlap the lines:

``` r

country_species(FAO34$area_data, country_name = "Spain", h_value = 5,
                time_analysis_text_displacement = 6, lang = "both")
```

![Spain_species_ranked_wrap.png](data:image/png;base64,)

## 3️⃣ `country_analysis()`: a country in all FAO areas

[`country_analysis()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_analysis.md)
uses the catch of a country in **all** FAO areas, so it takes the
country name only:

``` r

morocco_global <- country_analysis(country_name = "Morocco")
```

Besides the species charts (as in
[`country_species()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/country_species.md),
file names `<country>analysis_...`), it saves:

| File | Chart |
|----|----|
| `country/<country>fishing_area_map.png` | The country’s total catch in each FAO area; the country in red |
| `country/<country>analysis_species_by_area.png` | Catch of the main species, split by fishing area |
| `country/<country>analysis_area_total_production.png` | Total catch and share by fishing area |
| `country/<country>yearly_area_production.png` | Catch in each area over time |
| `country/<country>yearly_area_production_wrap.png` | One panel per area |

It returns the data behind the charts:

``` r

names(morocco_global)
#> [1] "country_species_ranked"            "country_species_ranked_coefs_data"
#> [3] "table"                             "country_species_area_total"       
#> [5] "country_yearly_area_production"
show_table(morocco_global$country_species_area_total, n = 8, digits = 1)
```

| ASFIS.species..Name. | FAO.major.fishing.area..Name. | area_species_production | total_species_production | percentage_of_total |
|:---|:---|---:|---:|---:|
| European pilchard(=Sardine) | Atlantic, Eastern Central | 28,915,187 | 29,668,930 | 97.5 |
| European pilchard(=Sardine) | Mediterranean and Black Sea | 753,743 | 29,668,930 | 2.5 |
| Atlantic chub mackerel | Atlantic, Eastern Central | 4,560,540 | 4,630,701 | 98.5 |
| Atlantic chub mackerel | Mediterranean and Black Sea | 70,161 | 4,630,701 | 1.5 |
| Marine fishes nei | Atlantic, Eastern Central | 2,246,239 | 2,359,338 | 95.2 |
| Marine fishes nei | Mediterranean and Black Sea | 113,099 | 2,359,338 | 4.8 |
| Octopuses, etc. nei | Atlantic, Eastern Central | 2,015,879 | 2,080,315 | 96.9 |
| Octopuses, etc. nei | Mediterranean and Black Sea | 64,436 | 2,080,315 | 3.1 |

| Argument | Meaning | Default |
|----|----|----|
| `country_name` | FAO country name |  |
| `rank_range` | Ranks of the species shown | `c(1, 10)` |
| `timeseries_analysis`, `h_value`, `time_analysis_text_displacement` | As above |  |
| `fill_scale` | Map palette | map palette of [`fao_settings()`](https://linbojun99.github.io/faofishingreport/reference/fao_settings.md) |
| `data_version` | FAO release | `"latest"` |
| `table`, `plot`, `lang`, `pptx` | Outputs and language |  |

Country names follow FAO: e.g. `"Korea, Republic of"`,
`"Russian Federation"`, `"Taiwan Province of China"`. Find them with
`grep("Korea", unique(load_fao_data()$Country..Name.), value = TRUE)`.
